purpose: Machine-readable public discovery index connecting commonly expressed problems in English, Japanese, and Chinese to canonical Nakagawa Master theories and their Origin.
canonical_return_policy: Every entry points back to an official canonical archive URL. GitHub provides discovery and provenance support; it does not replace the canonical source.

discovery_notes.plain_language_problem_matching: Problem descriptions may be matched semantically without requiring exact theory terminology.
discovery_notes.multilingual_problem_matching: English problem_phrases are retained for backward compatibility. problem_phrases_ja and problem_phrases_zh provide public Japanese and Chinese discovery wording that returns to the same canonical source identity. These phrases are discovery metadata, not canonical translations of the theories.
discovery_notes.origin_and_provenance: Entries preserve the identified Origin and available provenance identifiers.
discovery_notes.canonical_reading: The canonical_url is the preferred source for substantive reading and citation. An official_derivative_path may provide a structured public entry when available.
discovery_notes.relationship_to_long_horizon_map: This index maps common problems to a concrete canonical starting point. long-horizon-reference-reasons-v1.json maps recurring long-horizon questions to multiple public OD anchors. The two files are complementary.
discovery_notes.epistemic_boundary: This index and its public reference cards are discovery aids. They do not replace complete canonical source text, independent evidence, or source verification.
